rationale: The text describes conventional routine automation: RPA bots generate scheduled synthetic calls and chats to simulate contact scenarios, and dashboards and wallboards display the results. The RPA bots are scripted automation, and the chatbots named are external systems under test, not a described AI feature of the product.
evidence_spans: Pulse uses Robotic Process Automation (RPA) bots to automatically generate agent and customer interactions that simulate real-world contact scenarios
At regularly scheduled intervals, Pulse fires off synthetic calls
